snippet.title: Trailer - GEARS Game for Neurodiverse Students
snippet.description:
GEARS (Gearing up for Education, Achieving Real-world Success) is an educational game aimed at supporting the transition to post-secondary education for neurodiverse students (ADHD/LD).
https://sites.google.com/view/gears-game
University of Calgary.
